label: Production quotidienne de pétrole (réelle)
source: OPEC monthly report, Bloomberg, May 13 2026; Hormuz still effectively closed as of Aug 22, 2026
delta: A Sept 10 drone attack launched from Iraq's Maysan province forced a precautionary shutdown of the East-West pipeline, the kingdom's main Hormuz-bypass route, sending Brent above $108/barrel; Aramco restored the line to full 7M bpd capacity by Sept 15. A renewed Houthi offensive — a Sept 8 multi-province barrage (73 wounded) and a Sept 14 strike on King Khalid Air Base — triggered a 54-strike Saudi-led retaliation on Sept 15, underscoring how fragile export routes remain even as the pipeline itself recovered.
